rc.callSiteReachedWhen: Call site = scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:3942, nested inside `if use_fr10_tree:` (line 3921), itself inside `if spec_sequence_masks is not None:` (line 3889) in GatedDeltaNetAttention's spec/verify path of gdn_linear_attn.py. It is REACHED iff ALL hold on the verify forward: (1) spec_sequence_masks is not None (a spec-decode verify forward, true on every cat9 tree-verify); (2) use_fr10_tree is True, which (lines 3897-3902) requires os.environ FR10_ENABLE_TREE_GDN=="1" (set in launcher:306), _fr10_active_decode_mode=="tree_mtp" (read from rejection_sampler._FR10_DECODE_MODE, set per-request by the driver's vllm_xargs fr10_decode_mode=tree_mtp, default also "tree_mtp" at :784), attn_metadata.fr10_tree_parent is not None, and attn_metadata.num_spec_decodes>0. It is SKIPPED when ANY of those is false: notably (a) a PURE-DECODE step (no spec verify, spec_sequence_masks is None) — the deep-spine carrier only exists on a tree-verify event, so non-verify steps legitimately skip; (b) the request did NOT carry fr10_decode_mode=tree_mtp (decode mode != tree_mtp -> use_fr10_tree False -> native non-tree scan path taken, hook never in that branch); (c) tree disengaged so fr10_tree_parent is None / num_spec_decodes==0. The conv-site stash (:1900, `if _fr13_gdn_subop_mab_on:`) is gated ONLY on the enabled() flag, NOT on use_fr10_tree, so it stashes whenever spec verify runs + flag on. But the scan-site CALL (:3942) is gated on use_fr10_tree. So when the flag resolves ON but use_fr10_tree is False (decode-mode not tree_mtp, or env FR10_ENABLE_TREE_GDN absent in worker), the stash writes self._fr13_gdn_subop_mab_pre_conv/_conv_state and the call site is NEVER reached — the stash silently accumulates and is never consumed, zero records, zero log.
